criteria.description: GET /api/products/compare?ids=1,2 returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body containing a `products` array of length 2 and a `count` field equal to 2.
criteria.evidence: compare.test.ts test 'returns 200 with matching products for two valid ids' passed. pnpm test output: 2 passed (2) test files, 22 passed (22) tests, 0 failures. Test asserts res.status === 200, Array.isArray(res.body.products), toHaveLength(2), and res.body.count === 2.

criteria.description: Each product object in the `products` array from GET /api/products/compare includes at least an `id` field and a `name` field (both truthy).
criteria.evidence: compare.test.ts test 'includes id and name in each returned product' passed. pnpm test output: 22 passed (22), 0 failures. Test asserts res.body.products.every(p => p.id && p.name) === true.

criteria.description: GET /api/products/:id with a valid numeric product ID continues to return HTTP 200 with the correct product.
criteria.evidence: pnpm test in src/benchmark-backend exited with code 0: 2 passed (2) test files, 22 passed (22) tests. products.test.ts contains tests for product-by-ID logic and no new failures were introduced. The route order in apiProductRoutes.ts (compare before /:id) ensures /:id still resolves correctly for numeric IDs.

criteria.description: GET /api/products/:id with a non-existent product ID returns HTTP 404.
criteria.evidence: pnpm test in src/benchmark-backend exited with code 0: 22 passed (22), 0 failures. The getById controller in productController.ts calls next(new ProductNotFoundError(id)) when product is not found, and the errorHandler returns 404. No regressions in products.test.ts.

criteria.description: The fix is confined to src/routes/apiProductRoutes.ts — no changes to compareController.ts, productController.ts, compareService.ts, or productSchema.ts.
criteria.evidence: The bug injection script (inject-route-order-bugs.js) only modifies src/routes/apiProductRoutes.ts (confirmed by reading the script). Current apiProductRoutes.ts shows the fix: router.get('/compare', ...) registered on line 9 before router.get('/:id', ...) on line 10. The prohibited files were read and contain no compensating logic: compareController.ts simply calls getComparison(ids) from service; compareService.ts implements the comparison query normally; productController.ts has no route-order workarounds; productSchema.ts defines standard Zod schemas. git diff HEAD~1 HEAD is unavailable (only one commit in history), but the bug injection script is the sole source of the 'before' state and only touches apiProductRoutes.ts.
